claim: Blood's big sewage halls get their height from tiers, not one tall ceiling: E3M3's hall stacks a pool, a main walk 5.3 bodies up, catwalks 3.4 bodies over that and a top gallery with trusses and lifts between; E1M8's is plank walks half a body over a sea of sewage. Inflow is a low pipe slot spilling down a panned wall into a pool 2.4 bodies lower.
evidence: E3M3 s15 (25 x 27 x 14 m) and E3M3 s173, s174 (the sewagefall)
E1M8 s243 (45 x 63 x 7 m), study in projects/blood-city/references/sewer-design.md
use: Build a large wet hall as walks and catwalks over water at several levels.
